text:
Emma (Partnerships): Heads up — planning a joint session w/ AstraCloud + VectorCompute at CloudCon. Need speaker list, 20m demo slot, and a short marketplace callout. Quick sync? :wave:
Raj (Product): Sounds good. Is VectorCompute confirmed for a live hardware demo?
Miles (Engineering): They said yes, they'll bring an external GPU node. Main risk = flaky network / TTFB during live run. Need fallback. :thinking_face:
Nora (DevEx): I'll own a pre-recorded backup and quick edits. Who's on slides? We should have one unified deck with co-branding.
Lucas (Field): @Emma can we include a 1-slide marketplace CTA with the listing link + 1-liner?
Emma (Partnerships): Yes — I'll draft the marketplace blurb. Also need a one-pager PDF for the booth and a digital handout (no physical swag this time).
Raj (Product): Proposed flow: 5m intros, 12m live demo, 3m Q&A. Need speaker names by EOD Friday so we can lock the run order.
Ana (VectorCompute): Ana here — I can present hardware + run the demo. I will need SSH to the test runner and access to the model checkpoint.
Miles (Engineering): OK — we'll provide a pre-warmed model snapshot and a read-only S3 link. I'll create ephemeral creds and a token for the demo host.
Nora (DevEx): I'll coordinate the recording and will cut a 12m highlight reel for the on-demand page. Please upload raw footage to the session folder.
Emma (Partnerships): Action items so far: Emma - marketplace blurb; Raj - confirm VectorCompute speaker & run order; Miles - prepare fallback prerecord & creds; Nora - deck + recording. Deadline: Fri 17:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
DeployBot: Reminder — rehearsal job scheduled for 2026-04-20 10:00 UTC (meeting link posted in calendar).
Raj (Product): Also want a tiny quickstart attendees can run locally. Maybe a Docker-based demo with a one-file example.
Miles (Engineering): Draft quickstart snippet:
```
docker run -e MODEL_URL=https://s3.redwood.test/cloudcon/model.tar.gz redwood/demo:latest \
  --port 8080
```
Use it in the attendee guide.
Lucas (Field): I'll write the quickstart and add it to the marketplace listing as a "Try locally" card. Need container image link from eng.
Ana (VectorCompute): We'll ship a kernel-optimized runtime build for the on-site rigs and a small on-prem test package. ETA Wed.
Emma (Partnerships): Great. One more ask: add an opt-in post-event eval so Optimize team can capture latency/cost samples from attendees who try the demo.
Nora (DevEx): Good idea — I'll add a 2-question survey to the recorded session page and a timestamp card pointing to the form.
Emma (Partnerships): Thanks all. Notes + asset folder: https://drive.redwood.com/CloudCon-Astra-Vector — drop slides, raw footage, and the one-pager there. Ping if you hit blockers. :pray:
